name: Nanaka
source:
The oldest daughter of the four sisters living in the mansion. One could say she isn't even older sister-like at all: Nanaka is very carefree, energetic, immature and selfish, and has a bad relationship with all of her sisters except [url=/c34821]Kaoruku[/url]. Due to this, she is often called "unreliable sister" by the others.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=629165]Getchu[/url]]
